parallel_layout.source_policy: Separate native9:16 full-person sources; fixed proportional panel crops chosen after actual motion bounds QA, never stretch.
parallel_layout.size_match: Measure full hair, face, waist and shoe landmarks at opening and throughout; measure bag/skirt widest boundary. Same person height and panel image rectangle. Do not copy historical3.69% correction.
parallel_layout.motion: Independent ordinary-speed short same-side strap touch, settle and hand return; no forced timing synchronization or retiming.
parallel_layout.reading_check: Full outfit and cobalt bag readable at phone size; fine earrings detail belongs to proof asset.
parallel_layout.identity: Approved M04 v3 face/full anchors. Actual reference hair overrides conflicting general roster hairstyle.
